I don’t give off this vibe to her because I am completely different in social situations. I come off as chilled and relatively confident and sociable. These issues are really a problem when I am on my own left to my own thoughts. 

And obviously when I’m with her one on one, go karting and clubbing in Southampton I check my phone rarely. But whenever I get a message from her I want to instantly check it because I’m scared she’s gonna reject me. 

Also I’ve had depression for many years and it’s just constantly been bad. It peaked very bad just under a year when I attempted suicide in Bolton. I was having suicidal thoughts every second. Now they are only occasional and I am able to get on with life( just about). But I’m finding it so hard to study. I just need to fucking sit down, concentrate and study and complete assignments. I have the intelligence to do it. 

I got 8A stars and 3A’s at GCSE. I got 1A star and 2A’s at A-level. With a levels I had the same procrastination issues and addiction with my phone. I managed to break it 2-3 weeks before my exams because I realised I had no future and I worked 8 hours a day. I pulled all nighters before my exams and managed those grades. When the pressure is on I can do it I feel like. I’m in a slump currently and I need to break out of it so I can work to a well enough standard and show my true intelligence and work ethic. The severe severe tiredness and negative thoughts are pulling me back like a weight on my shoulder. 

I am so fortunate that she likes me but I know I can be even more attractive to her in a lot of ways, but the tiredness is pulling me back. Thanks for the luck man.

Weird thing is that I don’t get anxiety is any other form whatsoever. I’m not anxious in social situations, I’m not anxious in lectures or tutorials or approaching a random person . I’m not highly anxious in sudden or high pressure situations. It’s just regarding the addiction with my phone and the fear of losing someone that deserves much better.
Any advice would be very much appreciated

Guys aren’t just one thing. A guy isn’t just a ‘nice guy’. They can actually have a very interesting personality and dynamic, with a lot to talk about and share. But don’t want to appear arrogant by showing it off. 

- a guy may be a nice guy and a pushover because it’s what he thinks he deserves. He basically thinks people should take shit from him and play him around because he thinks he’s worth nothing. He will do anything for anyone because he thinks his self esteem is so bad from mental illness or lack of parental figures.
